scope: Week 2 Busan & Return to Seoul (Days 10-16 + repeated Day 9 block)

entries.name: Haeundae Beach
entries.verifiedFacts: 1.5 km white-sand public beach ~3–5 min walk from L7 Haeundae; free access.
entries.irregularities: Morning cafes/shops not named in itinerary.

entries.name: Haeundae Amso Galbi-jip (Haeundae Rib Barbecue Restaurant)
entries.verifiedFacts: MICHELIN Guide Busan Selected (₩₩, not starred); 11:30 opening confirmed.
entries.irregularities: Afternoon break window differs between MICHELIN Guide and VISITKOREA; 'arrive 30 min early' is unverified advice.

entries.name: Dongbaekseom Island & Dongbaek Coastal Trail
entries.verifiedFacts: Free ~950 m coastal boardwalk trail around Dongbaekseom at west end of Haeundae Beach.
entries.irregularities: 30–45 min walk duration is a pace estimate.

entries.name: Nurimaru APEC House
entries.verifiedFacts: Free admission; closed 1st Monday of month (open Tue Nov 10, 2026). Official Busan city Nurimaru page states 09:00–18:00 with last admission 17:00.
entries.irregularities: Visit Busan summary pages conflict between 17:00 and 18:00 closing; arrive before 17:00.

entries.name: Haeundae Blueline Park Sky Capsule (Mipo → Cheongsapo)
entries.where: Mipo Stn (13 Dalmaji-gil 62beon-gil) → Cheongsapo Stn (116 Cheongsapo-ro), Haeundae-gu, Busan
entries.verifiedFacts: 2 km elevated coastal ride (~30 min). Effective May 1, 2026 official fare revision: one-way Sky Capsule ₩50,000 (2p) / ₩55,000 (3p) / ₩60,000 (4p); Beach Train 09:00–19:00 (₩8,000–₩10,000 1-way, ₩14,000 2-ride, ₩16,000 all-stops); 2p Capsule+Train package ₩73,000.
entries.irregularities: Itinerary says 'Book round trip tickets', but Sky Capsule tickets are strictly one-way; return requires a second one-way capsule booking or the Beach Train.

entries.name: Cheongsapo Daritdol Observatory
entries.verifiedFacts: Free glass-bottomed coastal skywalk east of Cheongsapo Station; weather-dependent.
entries.irregularities: Visit Busan and VISITKOREA differ on whether evening hours (to 21:00) extend through November.

entries.name: BUSAN X the SKY (optional Day 10; also scheduled Day 12)
entries.verifiedFacts: Official operator admission Adult ₩29,000 / Child & Senior ₩26,000.
entries.irregularities: '$17.59 on klook' is a third-party OTA discount, not official admission; venue duplicated on Day 12.

entries.name: Gamcheon Culture Village
entries.verifiedFacts: Free village access (stamp map ₩2,000); Metro Line 1 Toseong Stn Exit 6 → Saha 1-1 / Seo 2 / Seo 2-2 village bus.
entries.irregularities: '2 buses, 1 hr & 17 min' from hotel is an unverified app estimate.

entries.name: Coffee It House
entries.irregularities: No official standalone business site or KTO/Visit Busan listing; address and hours left blank.

entries.name: BIFF Square
entries.verifiedFacts: Official Nampo-dong street-food plaza near Jagalchi Stn Exit 7 / Nampo Stn Exit 7.
entries.irregularities: Individual stall hours unconfirmed; listed twice on Day 11 (lunch and late afternoon).

entries.name: Jagalchi Market
entries.irregularities: Listed twice on Day 11 (midday and late afternoon).

entries.name: Songdo Beach & Songdo Cloud Trails
entries.verifiedFacts: Free 365 m overwater skywalk; Bus 26, 30, or 71 from Nampo Stn Exit 1.
entries.irregularities: '13 min bus, 9 min walk' duration unverified.

entries.name: Songdo Marine Cable Car / Busan Air Cruise (optional)
entries.verifiedFacts: Official operator fares: Air Cruise Adult ₩19,000 RT (₩15,000 OW); Crystal Cruise Adult ₩24,000 RT (₩19,000 OW).
entries.irregularities: Subject to wind/rain suspension.

entries.name: Gukje Market & Nampo-dong shopping streets
entries.hours: Gukje Market 09:00–20:00 (varies by shop; closed Sundays)
entries.irregularities: Spelled 'Gukje Marker' in source text; trailing empty item '9.' omitted.

entries.name: BUSAN X the SKY
entries.irregularities: 10:00–11:30 window is traveler preference; duplicated from Day 10 optional item.

entries.name: SEA LIFE Busan Aquarium
entries.verifiedFacts: Official online QR Adult ₩30,000 (Child ₩25,000); walk-up Adult ₩32,000 (Child ₩27,500).
entries.irregularities: '$15 ticket' in itinerary is not supported by official operator pricing.

entries.name: Open / rest day (Busan)
entries.irregularities: Intentionally unprogrammed in source itinerary.

entries.name: Gwangalli Beach & Gwangalli M Drone Light Show
entries.verifiedFacts: Busan 2026 event calendar & Suyeong-gu organizer confirm Saturday winter shows; 21st Busan Fireworks Festival is Sat Nov 7, 2026 (bfo.or.kr), so Sat Nov 14 has no fireworks conflict.
entries.irregularities: Subject to wind/rain cancellation; daytime before 17:00 and dinner restaurant unspecified.

entries.name: Open / rest day (Busan)
entries.irregularities: Intentionally unprogrammed in source itinerary.

entries.name: KTX Busan Station → Seoul Station
entries.irregularities: Uber '1 hour, $20–$30' to Busan Station and KTX departure/fare unconfirmed.

entries.name: AREX All-Stop: Seoul Station → Hongik Univ. Station
entries.verifiedFacts: Adult transit-card fare ₩1,550 (2 stops via Gongdeok).
entries.irregularities: AREX Express is non-stop Seoul Station ↔ ICN and does NOT stop at Hongik Univ. Station; must use All-Stop Train.

entries.name: Mercure Ambassador Seoul Hongdae
entries.verifiedFacts: Official Accor & Ambassador pages confirm address, 15:00/12:00 check-in/out, and Hongik Univ. Station Exit 9 access (~1–2 min surface walk; ~5 min from AREX).
entries.irregularities: Room reservation and onward departure flight out of Korea unconfirmed.
